name: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
title: Lightweight assistant
reason: A tiny assistant with optional thinking for everyday questions, code explanations, and light edits. Best as a utility model.

name: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B
title: Everyday coding
reason: For code edits and tool-assisted tasks with a moderate memory budget. Enable thinking for harder problems.

name: google/gemma-4-12B-it
title: General work and reasoning
reason: An instruction-tuned assistant with thinking and function calling, using Google's quantization-aware GGUF. Requires a runtime with Gemma 4 support.

name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
title: Complex coding and reasoning
reason: A newer dense model for difficult code changes, reasoning, and multi-step agent tasks. Budget memory beyond the weights for context and runtime overhead.

name: Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next
title: High-memory coding agents
reason: A coding-focused mixture-of-experts model with 80B total and 3B active parameters. The roughly 49 GB download makes this a workstation option; all weights still need memory.

name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
title: High-memory agent workflows
reason: An experimental model for coding, reasoning, and multi-step agent tasks. The three-part Q4_K_M download totals roughly 119 GB; allow additional memory for context and runtime overhead. Requires a runtime with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next support.
